tests.command: install exact local tarball offline and run inspect

limitations: Static manifest-only analysis; extension code is never executed.
No browser automation: the tool never launches, connects to, or controls a browser and observes no runtime behavior.
Coverage is limited to MV3 surfaces the analyzer recognizes; unrecognized manifest keys are ignored, not interpreted.
A report is a regression-testing plan, not evidence that an extension passed any test.
Comparisons do not predict Chrome Web Store review outcomes or prove an update is safe.
Manifests larger than 1 MiB are rejected and non-MV3 manifests exit with code 6.
